articles.title: Ondo Finance founder Nathan Allman dies unexpectedly
articles.snippet: Tokenized real-world assets firm Ondo Finance announced the unexpected death of founder Nathan Allman on Tuesday, with longtime president Ian De Bode stepping in as CEO.

articles.title: Grvt adds 3 tokenized yield funds tied to institutional-grade RWAs
articles.snippet: Grvt will work with Plume to launch tokenized fixed-income and structured credit products tied to institutional-grade real world assets and onchain yield strategies.

articles.title: Hyperliquid launches prediction markets for real-world events
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid launched canonical prediction markets for offchain events, expanding beyond perps as analysts frame it as an onchain superapp.

articles.title: Lucky Trader Rides $341 World Cup Meme Coin Buy to 14,000% Gains
articles.snippet: The trader still has over $100,000 worth of unrealized gains in the World Cup token, ahead of the start of the tournament next month.

articles.title: Famed iPhone, Sony Hacker Says AI Coding Agents Are a Disaster Waiting to Happen
articles.snippet: George Hotz spent six months testing agents on real projects and came away convinced they're creating an avalanche of undetectable slop—and that large organizations won't realize it until it's too late.
